operators.emphasize: restate or stress an element already in the original (e.g. make the count or the spatial relation explicit, repeat the key noun)
operators.reorder: move the missing element earlier in the sentence so the model attends to it first
operators.clarify: rephrase an ambiguous clause of the original into plainer visual language WITHOUT adding new content
operators.drop_clause: remove or shorten a clause that is pulling the image away from the missing element (the element itself must stay)
operators.revert: return to the ORIGINAL prompt wording

online.filters: lexical retention (no original element dropped) + Jev faithfulness guard (no content added)
online.encode: survivors encoded mid-trajectory and appended to this prompt's embedding bank

prune.rollout_policy: uniform over the leaf's kept set at all remaining key steps
